CustomField.description: Master eligibility flag. NOTE: In production, replace this with a Formula field once all dependent fields exist. Formula: AND(Exclude_From_Selection__c=FALSE, On_Leave__c=FALSE, Has_Open_Absence_Case__c=FALSE, OR(ISBLANK(Pool_Hold_Until__c), Pool_Hold_Until__c < TODAY())). Deployed as Checkbox initially to avoid dependency issues during deployment.
CustomField.label: Is Eligible For Testing
